elevenlabsPrompt:
[intrigued] Your phone buzzes with junk notifications all morning?

[confident] Here's the fix. Turn on Scheduled Summary.

[friendly] Open Settings, then Notifications. Tap Scheduled Summary and switch it on. Pick the apps. Leave messages out.

[delighted] The junk arrives in one tidy card, and messages still come straight through.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
